leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Construct a higher-order component (HOC) that wraps Angular components with authentication logic
Configure the HOC to accept a target component and return an enhanced component with auth checks
Implement authentication state management within the HOC using Angular services
Integrate the HOC with Angular's dependency injection system to access auth services
Apply the HOC to protect specific routes by wrapping route components
Manipulate component rendering based on authentication status (show/hide, redirect)
Initialize the HOC with configurable options for different authentication scenarios
